headline: Molfino Hnos Proposes Plan to Reactivate Lacteos Verónica Plants
summary: Molfino Hnos, part of Gloria Foods, proposed toll-processing contracts and an eventual purchase of two Lacteos Verónica dairy plants facing legal restructuring.
why: Corporate restructuring and asset acquisitions in the agricultural sector alter market concentration and production capacities.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Corporate restructuring of major dairy processing plants impacts local supply chains.
